chunks: And in the narration of Ḥarīz, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"The fasting person, if he fears for his eyes from ophthalmia, breaks the fast."
ai.seo_question: Can a fasting person break the fast because of an eye illness?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a fasting person may break the fast if they fear harm to their eyes due to eye inflammation. It indicates that illness and the fear of bodily harm are recognized grounds for الإفطار in the law of fasting.
